name: "Confetti Cake" Sandwich Cookies with Vanilla Icing & Sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line three large baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Or work in batches if necessary.)
Place eggs and oil in a large bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on high until smooth.
Add cake mix to the bowl with the egg mixture, then continue to blend, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed, until the batter is combined.

Use a large cookie scoop (or 1/8-cup measure) to portion cookies and arrange on the baking sheets, spacing them about 2-inches apart. Using your fingers, press the cookies into 2-1/2 inch circles. Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and bake until golden around the edges, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely, about 1 hour.

Spread about 2 tablespoons of icing on a cooled cookie, making sure to cover all the way to the edges. Close the cookie sandwich with a second cookie, pressing gently to adhere. Return cookie sandwich to the baking sheet, then repeat with remaining icing and cookies.
Place sprinkles on a plate. Working one at a time, roll the edges of the sandwich cookies, where the icing is exposed, in the sprinkles. Return to the baking sheet.
Arrange cookie sandwiches on a platter, share, and enjoy!
